name: Question - activation fee and AutoPay discount on a new line
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: analytical, wants numbers.
scripted_messages: Hi. Before I add a new line on Extra 2.0, I want to understand the fees. The plan page mentions an activation fee up to $50 and a cost recovery fee up to $4.99 per line. Can you explain what I'd pay on the first bill, and how the AutoPay discount of $10 would work?
Thanks. Is the activation fee charged once?
Okay. And what would the first bill be in total with everything included?
Got it, that's clearer than the website. You were so patient and friendly, thank you.
That's all, have a great day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 6: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
